title: ReconciliationRecord
description: A signed, anchored attestation that a print's cost_of_production_usd has been checked against a real provider invoice total and found within tolerance — docs/methodology.md §7. Deliberately never edits the print it reconciles: the print's own signed body (including status, permanently "provisional") is untouched. A print is 'final' when a valid record like this one exists for its print_id, checked by presence, never by a field on the print itself. Same relationship as a Receipt to a quote: a small, signed record referencing another artifact rather than embedding it.

decimalString.description: A decimal number encoded as a string. Never a JSON number — no floats in money maths.

schema_version.description: Build 1 emits "1.0". A same-major bump is additive and safe for an existing consumer to accept; a major bump is not.

print_id.description: The print this record reconciles — data/prints/<print_id>.json. This record never edits that file; it only references it.

computed_usd.description: Copied directly from the referenced print's own cost_of_production_usd — never recomputed independently. That field already sums every recorded attempt across every measured model (packages/print/src/compute/cost-of-production.ts), so there is exactly one computation of a print's real cost, not a second one that can silently drift from it.

invoice_usd.description: The real total across every provider actually billed for this print, summed from provider_breakdown. Must equal the sum of provider_breakdown's own invoice_usd values — enforced at signing time, not just documented.

provider_breakdown.description: One entry per real billing source consulted, so invoice_usd is auditable rather than a single opaque number. See docs/methodology.md §7 on isolating a shared API key's usage before recording a figure here.

provider.description: Matches a ModelRegistryEntry.provider value actually present in the referenced print's constituents (e.g. "openrouter", "anthropic", "openai", "google", "xai").

tolerance.description: The tolerance this reconciliation was checked against — DEFAULT_RECONCILE_TOLERANCE unless overridden. A record only ever exists when relative_delta was within this at signing time (see reconciled_at) — a reconciliation attempt that misses tolerance produces a console report, never a signed record; the print simply staying without one already discloses "not yet reconciled" honestly.

reconciled_at.description: When this reconciliation actually happened — necessarily well after the print's own date, since it depends on a real provider invoice becoming available. How long after the print a reader sees this took is part of the record, not implicit.

anchor.description: Anchored via the same TouchstoneAttestation contract and client a print uses (postPrint(bodyHash, version) — the contract never computes, validates or opines on a hash's contents, so no separate contract or ABI is needed).
